title: The sighing voice of sorrow sang. His sins. Since Easter he had cursed three times. You bitch’s bast. And once at masstime he had gone to play. Once by the churchyard he had passed and for his mother’s rest he had not prayed. A boy. A croppy boy.
html_source: Paraphrasing the lyrics of The Croppy Boy. This must imagine Stephen, especially before he appears in Ulysses.
